subGoals.family: H-port bypass: the application imports an outbound adapter
subGoals.rule: No file of the core (src/domain, src/application) imports, re-exports, loads or refers to a module or symbol of src/adapters or src/main.ts, type-only included; a use case reaches the GPS provider through an out-port written in core types (ARCHITECTURE.md 1 and 2; Cockburn 2005, ports and adapters).

subGoals.family: H-composition bypass: the application constructs a concrete adapter
subGoals.rule: No core file constructs (new, Reflect.construct) a class declared in src/adapters or src/main.ts; adapters are built in src/main.ts and handed to the use cases (ARCHITECTURE.md 3).
